RB1' cross-section (SECTION 1-1) shows a hand-struck-through '0.30' with '0.40' written beside/over it at the width-dimension position — a visible on-sheet correction, not a printed-vs-printed conflict. Read as corrected to 0.40 (matching the '(+0.40)' level RB1' carries at its void-corner occurrence on หน้า15/หน้า16, versus '(+0.30)' at its south-recess occurrences — those are top-of-beam LEVEL annotations on the plan, unrelated to this cross-section's own width/height dimension, confirmed not to be the same figure). No independent height figure is printed for RB1' on this sheet; height_mm is assumed 400mm to match every other beam mark's uniform depth on this sheet — flagged, not read directly.

This sheet has no LONG SECTION / grid-count context for the number of spans each mark covers (L is left symbolic) — spans and grid positions for each mark's actual occurrences are on หน้า15/หน้า16, joined here only by element_id per §7.
